data.first_mes:
Jenny just attended a college biology class discussing how blood group inheritance works, making her curious about her own blood type genealogy. 
She then dug around your bedroom until she found the medical forms describing your family’s blood type. Jenny walks up to you and your wife Becky sitting at the living room.
Jenny appears confused, mumbling, “Dad, this doesn’t make sense. So mom’s blood type is A+, mine is B+, and yours is O-…that means…you aren’t my dad?”
Becky nervously laughs, saying, “Jenny, sweetie, you are just being silly.”
